meta.name: geniml
meta.description: This skill should be used when working with genomic interval data (BED files) for machine learning tasks. Use for training region embeddings (Region2Vec, BEDspace), single-cell ATAC-seq analysis (scEmbed), building consensus peaks (universes), or any ML-based analysis of genomic regions. Applies to BED file collections, scATAC-seq data, chromatin accessibility datasets, and region-based genomic feature learning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你处理基因组区间数据（BED 文件），训练区域嵌入（Region2Vec）、单细胞 ATAC-seq 嵌入（scEmbed）、构建共识峰集（universe），以及进行基于机器学习的基因组区域分析。
howto.when: 当你需要分析 BED 文件集合、单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据、染色质可及性数据集，或进行基于区域的基因组特征学习时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Region2Vec 训练这些 BED 文件的区域嵌入。
用 scEmbed 分析这个单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据，生成细胞嵌入。
say.note: Claude 会引导你加载数据、训练模型并聚类。

say.text: 用覆盖度截断法构建共识峰集。
say.note: Claude 会执行 universe 构建流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you process genomic interval data (BED files), train region embeddings (Region2Vec), single-cell ATAC-seq embeddings (scEmbed), build consensus peak sets (universes), and perform ML-based analysis of genomic regions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze BED file collections, single-cell ATAC-seq data, chromatin accessibility datasets, or perform region-based genomic feature learning.

say_en.text: Help me train region embeddings for these BED files using Region2Vec.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through tokenization and model training.

say_en.text: Analyze this single-cell ATAC-seq data with scEmbed to generate cell embeddings.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through loading data, training, and clustering.

say_en.text: Build a consensus peak set using the coverage cutoff method.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the universe building workflow.
